bearingSource: OSM way 512605871 (coarse trace) long axis 27.7°; its rounded end is at the NNE, and the November photographs show the stair side lit in the morning (01) and the opposite side in the afternoon (03, 04), which fits an NNE–SSW axis. +X = 27.7° towards the polygonal apse; the stair/entrance side faces +Z (≈ 118°, ESE).
approximations: The OSM outline is a coarse 10-node trace including the stair; the plan (nave + pronaos 12.2 × 6.8 m, three-sided apse 5.2 m wide, total ≈ 15.8 m) and the heights (plinth ≈ 1.3 m levelled, log walls ≈ 2.4 m, hipped roof ≈ 45° with steeper hip ends, turret ≈ 1.9 m above the ridge) are scaled from the photographs. Log courses, corner notches and posts are stylised; window positions on the north side are interpreted. The separate timber bell tower is not modelled. All photographs date from November 2011 and show galvanised sheet; the roofs, the turret cladding and its cap are shown in weathered copper, the material supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records (2019); which surfaces were re-covered is not documented.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii publice de referință; dimensiunile și forma acoperișului absidei sunt aproximate. Fotografiile disponibile (2011) sunt anterioare lucrărilor, de aceea acoperișurile și turnulețul sunt redate în cuprul livrat de COLOR METAL, conform evidențelor firmei, cu patină brună.
note.hu: Nyilvános referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett; a méretek és az apszis tetőformája közelítőek. A rendelkezésre álló fotók (2011) a munkálatok előttiek, ezért a tetők és a kis torony a COLOR METAL nyilvántartása szerint szállított, barnára patinásodott rézzel jelennek meg.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs; dimensions and the apse roof form are approximate. The available photographs (2011) predate the works, so the roofs and the turret are shown in the copper supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records, weathered brown.
